item.blurb: Khaime Raises $500,000 Pre-seed. Khaime raises $500,000 in pre-seed funding led by Launch Africa Ventures to build an AI-native commerce platform for human and AI shoppers.
Origin Frame Secures Pre-seed Funding. Origin Frame secures pre-seed funding from Z Venture Capital and East Ventures to develop its AI-powered 3D anime character creation platform.
Eight by Zero Raises $3M Seed. Eight by Zero raises $3M seed round led by Diagram to expand its AI-powered data connectivity platform for the insurance and benefits industry.
Soket AI Raises Seed Round. Soket AI Labs raises a seed round co-led by Bajaj Finance, Pennant Technologies, and IndiaAI Mission to advance sovereign AI and foundation models.
Modern Industrials Raises $6M Seed. Modern Industrials raises $6M in seed funding led by Glasswing Ventures and TMV to deploy custom AI agents for industrial manufacturers and distributors.
Heylist Raises $3.1M Seed. Heylist raises CAD $3.1M in a seed round led by Amiral Ventures to expand its AI-powered influencer marketing platform across North America and Europe.
